description: This PHP source file defines a view for a subpanel in the SuiteCRM application, specifically for the Leads module. It initializes a ListView object with a specific template and header, and handles layout editing for admin users.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in the SuiteCRM interface.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes the ListView with a specified HTML template and language strings.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title of the ListView, combining the module name and optional layout edit link.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and displays the list view for the focus list data set.
